item.title: Who Is Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf?
item.summary: A brigadier general and speaker of Parliament, Mr. Ghalibaf, one of the leaders of Iran’s war effort, has emerged as a potential contact point in any peace talks.

item.title: Trump Says He’s Talking With Iran. Iran Says He’s Not. Here’s Why.
item.summary: The president has domestic and international political motivations for touting negotiations to end the war. Iran has similar ones to deny discussions.

item.title: Israel Races to Hit Iran Hard While It Still Can, Officials Say
item.summary: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu gave the order on Tuesday for the military to accelerate its attacks, with a 48-hour deadline, four people briefed on the matter said.

item.title: Iranians Reject Trump’s Offer for Cease-Fire but Signal Openness to Talks
item.summary: Iran does not want a momentary pause in the fighting, fearing that Israel and the United States would use that opportunity to beef up their forces before resuming strikes.

item.title: Israel Keeps Up Strikes in Lebanon as Hezbollah Signals Defiance
item.summary: There were few signs that either side was prepared to step back from the fighting. Israel said it struck an area south of Beirut and issued new evacuation warnings.

item.title: Iraq Summons U.S. Diplomat After Attack on Military Base
item.summary: The attack came a day after a separate strike on the same base, which hosts units viewed by the United States as allies of Iran.

item.title: Trump Had His Eye on China, Then Plunged Into a New Mideast War
item.summary: The Trump administration said the Middle East would “recede” in importance as the China challenge took priority. But the president started the Iran war.

item.title: U.S. and Iran Are Talking About Ways to End the War: What to Know
item.summary: The United States is discussing ways to end hostilities with Iran, even as President Trump continues to threaten attacks and as the Pentagon dispatches more troops.

item.title: NATO’s ‘Trump Whisperer’ Faces Blowback Over Support for Iran War
item.summary: Critics say Mark Rutte, the alliance’s secretary general, has gone beyond his remit by openly supporting a war that does not directly involve Europe’s collective defense.

item.title: Cheap Drones Remain Wild Card in Iran war
item.summary: Stopping Iran’s production of drones is critical to opening the Strait of Hormuz and halting its attacks on Gulf nations. But can it be done?
